title: Design: Picked status leaves the green Active pill in place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 3.2 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The title row shows a green "Active" pill and the Active radio is filled blue.

Step 3:

  • The Inactive radio is filled blue with a light blue halo around it, and Active is empty.
  • The pill in the title row still reads "Active" in green.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed on the Active tab: picking Inactive changed nothing.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R21: “Picking a different status changes nothing until Save. When Save is pressed with a different status picked, the confirmation of Story 10 opens first.”
  • S13-R25: “The title row pill shows the saved status, not the picked one.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
